args.query: margin profile null FNO order validation NullPointerException
order placement 500 error rate spike validation refactor

events.statement: order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (pre-12:00) to ~14.7% in the 12:10 bucket and stayed ~18-19% through 13:59.
The first error log in order-service is at 12:12:31Z, inside the same 10-minute bucket where error_rate spiked; the incident onset is therefore ~12:12Z.

Every order-service error is a NullPointerException in the new MarginCheckValidator.validate, with 'marginProfile is null' and orderType=FNO. 426 ERROR entries total; 224 are the NPE pattern and 202 the rejection pattern.
Deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, 12:10:00Z) introduced 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and removed 'legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'; it is live and not rolled back.
The rollout-complete log for dep-5101 is at 12:10:08Z, ~2.5 minutes before the first error at 12:12:31Z.
The only config change in the window is notification-service 'email.batch_size' 200->250 at 11:21Z, unrelated to order validation.

pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and ledger-db show zero ERROR logs across 08:00-13:59Z, and order-service latency_p99 (~150ms), cpu (~40%), memory (~60%) and request_rate (~233 req/s) are flat across the incident.
No EQ (non-derivative) order produced any error; only orderType=FNO orders appear in the failures, matching the report's 'mostly derivatives orders'.
No order-service restarts occurred during the window (restarts metric stays 0), and db_pool_in_use stays ~14 connections (no saturation).
Errors are continuous and steady from 12:12 to 13:58 (~18-19% error rate, no recovery), consistent with a persistent code defect rather than a transient blip or recovery.
